name: Code
description: Building on OpenCode to connect coding workflows with VOLPAROSSA's cooperative compute foundation.
scope: A bounded local model can read, edit and test a public fixture. Native editor operation and confidential peer coding remain unfinished.

name: Image
description: Building on Immich to connect photo libraries with VOLPAROSSA's shared storage foundation.
scope: Encrypted snapshot recovery has a scoped peer-storage proof. Live library operation, device sync and server-independent mobile use remain unfinished.

name: Cloud
tagline: More room for what comes next.
description: Building on OpenCloud to connect files and collaboration with VOLPAROSSA's shared infrastructure.
scope: The original Files interface has scoped upload and recovery proofs. Accounts, sharing, writable sync and recovery on another device remain unfinished.

name: Browser
description: Protected connectivity, eligible content caching and cooperative AI for a familiar browser.

name: Chat
description: Messaging and calls with private backups, preserving Signal Protocol semantics.

name: Mail
description: Existing email accounts, cooperative delivery and optional self-hosting.

name: Map
description: Offline maps and navigation, with shared map data and positioning research.

name: Weather
description: Direct public weather-model data, beginning with ECMWF, shared through Core.

name: Studio
description: Visual website creation, portable export and a path toward shared hosting.

name: Bank
description: Participant-owned portfolio and transaction research. No live banking or payment service.

name: Citizen
description: Proposals and referendum procedures using fictional identities. Real-person voting remains open.
